findings.claim: The audience paragraph added by MIN-SAFE-002 inline-fix reads: 'your pre-push verification is covered by the SCP reusable workflow you wired in §12.1'. Section §12.1 in ADOPT-001 is titled 'Extract, do not reinvent' (line 721) — a design-principles section listing six numbered philosophical principles. It is NOT the section where adopters wire the SCP reusable workflow. The correct reference is §12.7.1 'Minimal caller wrapper' (line 759), which instructs adopters to add `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` to their repo via a pinned SHA `uses:` line. An adopter following the §12.1 cross-reference lands on design principles, not workflow-wiring instructions. The error was introduced by the fix-round-1 MIN-SAFE-002 edit and did not exist in the pre-fix-round-1 surface.
findings.evidence: ADOPT-001 grep: '### 12.1 Extract, do not reinvent' at line 721; '#### 12.7.1 Minimal caller wrapper' at line 759 ('Add this file at `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` in your repo'). Audience paragraph at ADOPT-001 line 1014: '...covered by the SCP reusable workflow you wired in §12.1'. §12.1 and §12.7.1 are distinct sections; §12.1 is a design-principles enumeration, §12.7.1 is the adopter workflow-wiring instruction.
findings.impact: Low. The primary audience-dispatch message ('Adopter repos do not need this wrapper') is unambiguous and bolded — the audience dispatch works correctly. An adopter who follows the §12.1 link finds six design principles rather than workflow-wiring instructions. The navigation failure is low-impact because adopters reading §12.7.9.1 will have already completed §12.7.1 wiring during onboarding. However, the cross-reference is objectively wrong and is a new inaccuracy introduced by fix-round-1.
findings.mitigation: One-word inline fix in ADOPT-001 §12.7.9.1 audience paragraph (line ~1014): change 'in §12.1' to 'in §12.7.1'. Corrected sentence: '...covered by the SCP reusable workflow you wired in §12.7.1, and the SHA-pinning warnings in the parent §12.7.9 do not apply to invocations from inside the SCP repo itself.' Bundle with close-out commit (AC(xiv)) or next ADOPT-001 touching PR. Does not require fix-round-2.
